app.name: HeartTune
app.tagline: Check your heart with one finger

start.title: Ready to measure your heart rate?
start.guide1: Place your index finger gently on the rear camera
start.guide3: Hold still until the measurement ends

measuring.live: Measuring… final value shown when done
measuring.tooBright: Too bright here. Try again in the shade

brady.title: Your heart is beating slowly
brady.desc: Your heart rate is on the low side. This can be normal for athletes, but see a doctor if you feel dizzy or tired.

normal.title: Within the normal range
normal.desc: Your resting heart rate is in the normal range.

tachy.title: Your heart is beating fast
tachy.desc: You may have just exercised or feel stressed. Try again in 5 minutes.

rhythm.irregular: Your rhythm looks uneven. Please consult a doctor
rhythm.short: Measurement was short — treat the rhythm as a rough guide

history.title: History
history.note: Records are stored on this device only

legal.disclaimer: This app is not a medical device. Results are for reference only and do not replace a medical diagnosis.
legal.privacy: Camera images are processed on your device only and are never transmitted.

error.noCamera: Camera unavailable. Please check browser permissions
error.denied: Camera permission was not granted. If no prompt appeared, the embedded view is blocking it — tap [Open in new tab] to use a regular browser
error.notSecure: The camera only works over HTTPS

pwa.installTitle: Add to your home screen to use it like an app
